faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about Tekizz

q1.question: What is Tekizz?
q1.answer: Tekizz is an interactive learning platform designed for developers and tech enthusiasts. It transforms learning into a fun experience through adaptive quizzes and an engaging gamification system.

q2.question: How does the difficulty system work?
q2.answer: The difficulty system is progressive and automatic. You start at Easy level and, based on your performance, the game gradually increases difficulty: Medium, Hard, then Expert. This ensures a challenge adapted to your level.

q3.question: What question categories are available?
q3.answer: Tekizz covers a wide range of tech domains: Backend (Java, Spring Boot), Frontend (React, Vue, Angular), DevOps (Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD), Data Science, Cybersecurity, and many more. New categories are regularly added.

q4.question: Is Tekizz free?
q4.answer: Yes, Tekizz is completely free. Simply create your account and start playing immediately. No payment required to access all features.

q5.question: How can I track my progress?
q5.answer: A comprehensive dashboard lets you visualize your statistics: global score, accuracy by category, game history, and your position in the leaderboard. All your data is automatically synchronized.
